discription: A pulse wave with pulse width modulation (PWM) creating a drone-like texture, with a simple ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=444, amp=0.1, gate=1, pw=0.5, pmFreq=0.5, pmDepth=0.1;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var pmSig = SinOsc.kr(pmFreq) * pmDepth + pw;    sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pmSig) * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
